class logic.db_schemaClasses.Vehicle(regPlate, typeOfVehicle, fuelType, makeAndModel, isCurrentlyTaxed, manufacturedDate, taxExpiryDate, lastServicedDate)

Bases: object

represents a vehicle, as stored in the database. This is the only file in the codebase to define the avaliable vehicle-attributes (regPlate, fuelType, etc.), EXCEPT FOR editVehicleDialog, vehicleFilterCriteria, and filterVehiclesDialog.
